title: Communicate prerequisites between planned features
statement: As a product manager, I can map dependencies between Roadmap features so the team understands which capabilities are prerequisites for others.
overview: The first example is self-hosted onboarding depending on self-hostable server mode. A Gantt presentation is a possible future direction; scheduling rules, enforcement, and graph interaction are not yet specified.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A product owner can record that self-hosted onboarding depends on self-hostable server mode, and a reader can identify which feature is the prerequisite.
